_comment: Where a review write-up goes, and who to @ in it. Routing follows Chris's watcher: by feature workstream, NOT by repo — price-comparison-tool PRs land in three different channels depending on subject. Add a channel here only once the bot can post to it: public channels work via chat:write.public, private ones need @Lex Bot invited.
_fallback_comment: Used when the chosen channel AND the default both reject the post, so a write-up is never lost to a routing or permissions mistake. #web-app-team is private and the bot is not yet a member — until it is invited, every post lands here instead and says so in the log.

web-app-team.for: DEFAULT. Anything without a clear feature home: front-end work, auth-service, user-service, subscriptions, infra/CI, cross-cutting changes. Use this when in doubt.

backend-pr-reviews.for: Backend-only work with no feature home — groceries-backend, price-comparison-backend, service plumbing and data jobs.

feature-groceries.for: Grocery basket/cart/saved-list work in any repo — the pct grocery chat panel, acb grocery tools and geocoding for grocery flows, groceries-backend feature work.

feature-ai-chat-bot.for: Milton chat itself — chat UI, sidebar, memory, streamdb/client-core chat state, the acb turn pipeline and card actions.

feature-mobile-apps.for: price-comparison-apps — the native iOS / React Native app, its CI, and client-core pins consumed by it.

_users_comment: github login → slack id. An unmapped author is printed as plain text and mentions nobody, which is the safe failure — a wrong id pings the wrong person.
